$comment: Lava (docs/proposals/VOLCANOES.md §6, phase V1): hot fluids on their own surface grid (`dwell-lava`), a depth and a heat per 1 m column, moving by the viscous gravity-current law (flow per metre of width = g × h³ × surface slope / (3 × viscosity), through the depth above `yieldDepthM`, so a thin front stands still), scheduled like the water: every lava tick near a player, fast-forwarded in one run elsewhere. Times are real seconds × `speed`. tickEvery: server ticks per lava tick near a player. nearRadiusM: a field with a player this close runs every lava tick. farEverySeconds: a far field runs the time it owes once it owes this much. cfl: a substep's share of the explicit law's stable step (cell² / (4 × the fastest face's g h³ / 3ν)). maxSubsteps: the most substeps one run takes (more, and the rest of its time is lost). stepDepthM (V2): a substep is sized for lava up to this deep; deeper ponds level through the flux limit (no face moves more than the stable share of its two surfaces' difference) instead of shrinking every substep. maxTiles (V2): a growing field's most tiles of 8 × 8 columns, the cap on its area (a field covers the tiles its lava reaches, and drops the ones all rock). fluids: each hot fluid, by name (`name`; a field and a vent name theirs): viscosityM2s (kinematic, m²/s; higher is slower), yieldDepthM (a depth that never flows: the front's crust), coolingSeconds (a column at rest, thinDepthM deep, from vent heat to rock), edgeCooling (how much faster per dry neighbour: lava cools from its edges), thinDepthM (lava this deep cools in coolingSeconds; thinner faster and deeper slower, in proportion: it cools from its top), tubeSpeedMs (V2: moving lava keeps its heat under its crust, a tube: its cooling is divided by 1 + speed / tubeSpeedMs, so a running river stays molten far from its vent and its front, once stopped, cools at the full rate), rock (the block it cools into: new land), quench (lava running into a water column: `rock` at once, raising the sea floor until it stands above the water as new land, the quench edge, and a steam event turning `steamWaterM` of the water's depth to steam), light (the light level its block gives, 0–15; the block itself comes with the look), damagePerSecond (health a second to a player in it), burnSeconds and burnDamagePerSecond (the burning after leaving it). Prototype tuning (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/fluids/lava.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-lava/src/lava.gen.rs is stale.
